mapper.insert: INSERT INTO business (owner_id, name, ceo_name, biz_reg_no, start_date, address, phone, website, verify_status, business_reg_doc_key, approval_status) VALUES (#{ownerId}, #{name}, #{ceoName}, #{bizRegNo}, #{startDate}, #{address}, #{phone}, #{website}, #{verifyStatus}, #{businessRegDocKey}, #{approvalStatus})
mapper.select: SELECT business_id, owner_id, name, ceo_name, biz_reg_no, start_date, address, phone, website, verify_status, business_reg_doc_key, approval_status, reject_reason, reviewed_by, reviewed_at, created_at FROM business WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT business_id, owner_id, name, ceo_name, biz_reg_no, start_date, address, phone, website, verify_status, business_reg_doc_key, approval_status, reject_reason, reviewed_by, reviewed_at, created_at FROM business WHERE business_id = #{businessId}
mapper.update: UPDATE business SET verify_status = #{verifyStatus} WHERE business_id = #{businessId}
mapper.select: SELECT business_id FROM business WHERE business_id = #{businessId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT business_id, owner_id, name, ceo_name, biz_reg_no, start_date, address, phone, website, verify_status, business_reg_doc_key, approval_status, reject_reason, reviewed_by, reviewed_at, created_at FROM business WHERE approval_status = #{approvalStatus} ORDER BY created_at DESC
